# Count unique songs per artist
from collections import defaultdict

artist_song_count = defaultdict(set)  # artist name -> set of song_ids

for song_id, song in song_details.items():
    for artist in song['artists']:
        artist_song_count[artist['name']].add(song_id)

# Convert to counts
artist_counts = {artist: len(song_ids) for artist, song_ids in artist_song_count.items()}

# Sort by count descending, then by name ascending for deterministic tie-breaking
sorted_artists = sorted(artist_counts.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))

# Get top 3
top3 = [artist for artist, count in sorted_artists[:3]]
print("Top 3 artists:", top3)
print("Counts:", [(artist, artist_counts[artist]) for artist in top3])
